title: Oozy Garlicky Syrian Tofu Tacos
description: A creamy and indulgent Syrian dish featuring crispy taco shells filled with garlicky tofu, perfect for a Jain-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Dehydrate the tofu by wrapping it in a clean kitchen towel and letting it sit for 30 minutes.
Crumble the tofu into small pieces and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the crumbled tofu to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in the lemon juice, sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Arrange the taco shells on a baking sheet and fill each shell with the tofu mixture.
Drizzle the vegan mayo over the top of each taco.
Sprinkle the toasted pita bread crumbs over the top of each taco.
Bake the tacos in the preheated oven for 10 minutes until the shells are crispy.
